label: Start with appliance evidence data
details: ENERGY STAR and NRCan give verified appliance model records and performance metrics before retail offers.

label: Use Best Buy API for appliance/current retail rows
details: Best Buy's API is a strong current/historical product catalog for appliances and related electronics, but needs an API key.

label: Use GS1/ECCnet for Canadian packaged goods identity
details: GS1 Canada ECCnet is likely useful for housewares, kitchenwares, apparel and appliance GTIN/product content, but needs access.

label: Use fashion datasets for clothing taxonomy/attributes
details: Kaggle/Hugging Face/Fashionpedia/Atlas/iMaterialist sources are useful for category, image and attribute training, not necessarily live prices.

label: Normalize to multiple Comparator row types
details: Separate live retail offers, product identity records, certification/evidence records and fashion attribute/taxonomy records.
